label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Notion Application at exact World interface world_mcp_notion. Installation proves only that the package owners are present; availability requires the real project EE policy, task connection requires the exact interface binding plus this artifact binding, and none of those facts proves a live remote server. Use its emitted catalogs for Notion pages, databases, blocks, search, comments, and workspace capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Treat mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates, and mcp.prompt_catalog artifacts emitted by world_mcp_notion as the current server evidence. To invoke a discovered tool, emit an ordinary artifact.send to world_mcp_notion with label mcp.operation.request and a payload whose operation is notion.call_tool and whose arguments carry the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use notion.read_resource, notion.get_prompt, and notion.complete only with exact catalog identifiers; use notion.status or notion.ping when liveness or negotiated capability matters. A sent request is not proof of a world effect: wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event, or refusal artifact and report failures honestly. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens, and refresh state remain private to the interface; carry only non-secret handles and status artifacts across Octopus boundaries.
